data_fields.name: race_hearing
data_fields.donor_constant: per race (cave spider 8, wolf 30) from monster.txt

data_fields.name: race_smell
data_fields.donor_constant: per race (wolf 50) from monster.txt; oldest scent age it can follow

data_fields.name: noise_step
data_fields.donor_constant: 1 per step; 4 under cover of tracks

data_fields.name: fear_big_hit_pct
data_fields.donor_constant: 80 (when the hit leaves no more than the damage)

data_fields.name: fear_time_big_hit
data_fields.donor_constant: randint1(10) + 20 when pct > 7; else randint1(10) + (11 - pct) * 5

best_idea: A monster's whole move decision is one ordered chain (track by sight, then sound from a per-turn noise flood, then scent age; then terrain, pack ambush, fear run, pack surround, fallback), with a power-score fear test and per-race sensing numbers.
decision_why: Keep the ordered chain, the power-score fear test, the damage fear roll and the pack ambush rule; replace the morale term (index bit 3, arbitrary) with a seeded per-creature draw shown in the row; state the +25 offset as a named data field; cap the afraid hold as data.
acceptance: A server test: a pack creature with the player in open ground above half HP moves to an unseen ambush spot at least distance*3/4+2 away and does not charge; a creature hit for half its remaining HP (or on the 10 percent roll) gets a fear timer and runs; a creature with no move while afraid is held for the capped number of turns.
